simple.meaning: עָשֵׁן (ʻâshên) is a Hebrew word meaning “smoky.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עָשֵׁן (H6226) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 20:18, with occurrences in Exodus, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָשֵׁן (H6226) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עָשֵׁן (H6226) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עָשֵׁן (ʻâshên) / H6226 is traced through Exodus 20:18, Isaiah 7:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

timeline.evidenceText: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
